# @callstack/example-license-mit-or-gpl-3.0

This is a test package with the license expression `MIT OR GPL-3.0-only` (a Dual License of a permissive and a strong copyleft license), for the needs of example tester projects in this monorepository to depend on, to test that license-kit parses, renders and classifies SPDX license expressions.

Expected category: strong copyleft with `--or-policy most-restrictive` (the default), permissive with `--or-policy least-restrictive`.
